edits.before: Trade around the bomb: four stacks detonate — back off at three or commit at four; never linger between.
edits.after: His lack of a dash leaves him open through levels 4-5 — every step forward to E-Defile the wave is a free jump-in.

edits.before: E the bomb, stack two autos, and step back at three — the threat does the zoning and the fourth stack stays loaded.
edits.after: His Q-Lay Waste has a cast delay you can step through — bomb-stack while he's mid-animation, not after he resets.

edits.before: Jumping in with the bomb unstacked and R down — Tristana without the string is a yordle tourist at a gunfight.
edits.after: Diving without a plan invites a Requiem snipe on low HP — he doesn't even need to be at the fight to end it.

edits.before: Karthus spends Requiem early — the closest thing this matchup has to a guarantee.
edits.after: His R-Requiem is a channel — hard CC cancels it outright. Trade CC, don't tank it.

edits.before: That’s Karthus’s bread-and-butter play — deny it and they run out of answers.
edits.after: Wall of Pain cuts retreat — no dash to answer it; hold Flash for wall, not damage.
